create_scorer_with_get_scorer: create a scorer object using get_scorer with a built-in scorer name like accuracy or roc_auc
build_custom_scorer_with_make_scorer: build a custom scorer from a metric function using make_scorer with response_method and kwargs
test_check_scoring_validator: test the check_scoring validator handles single metric strings, dicts, lists, and callables correctly
run_multimetric_scorer_evaluation: run multiple scorers at once using _MultimetricScorer to evaluate predictions across several metrics
create_curve_scorer_for_thresholds: create a _CurveScorer that computes metric scores across a range of classification thresholds
